reviewScope: All 1505 JPEG-format stills fully decoded and reviewed chronologically in 19 contact sheets. The opening 120 images were also inspected in a separate review sheet. All 314 shortlisted candidates were reviewed again at up to 492 pixels; three cover candidates were compared at 1600 pixels. All source files decoded successfully.
dateSource: Camera-local EXIF capture timestamps, retained without conversion. Selected offset tags record +05:30. Unoffset phone timestamps remain as recorded without assuming synchronized clocks. Undated shared copies and the Canon set with July timestamps are omitted rather than assigned inferred December dates.
locationNotes: Visible landmarks, readable signs, capture order and consistent original GPS establish places. Exact original GPS is not copied into this manifest or published derivatives.
Some original GPS tags jump away from the visibly continuous route. Stale or conflicting fixes are disregarded; uncertain stops between Khonoma and Dzüleke use the broad road label.

The photographed cathedral, war cemetery, festival grounds, signed Khonoma Fort and visible village map support specific place labels. The red-roofed church at the beginning of the Kohima sequence remains unnamed.
All 25 files named .CR2 contain JPEG data and have corresponding Canon .JPG portraits with the same recorded timestamps. No RAW development was performed; all source names and contents remain intact.
No itinerary was present. No completed archive for this collection was present at review time; the existing extracted originals were reviewed without extraction or renaming.
Originals, videos, screenshots, private travel records and review sheets stay outside the website and R2. Only selected metadata-free WebP derivatives are exported.
criteria: Choose distinct clear landscapes, architecture, interiors, wildlife, food and candid daily life; compare bursts and avoid padding limited days.
Group by actual local capture date and location; shorter sections are retained for isolated daily-life photographs.
Keep each cover once in its album and daily count, without repeating it in the gallery.
Preserve original framing and colour, correct EXIF orientation, omit EXIF/XMP, and export quality-84 WebP at 2000 pixels or 2400 for covers.
Local people, performances, crowds and incidental visitors are allowed. peoplePhotoSources is a conservative list to support later review without identifying or matching faces.
omissionReasons: Repeated scenes and near-identical bursts, weaker framing, blurred and badly exposed frames, and most posed portraits.
Screenshots, private documents, undated shared copies, and the posed Canon set with July timestamps.
Routine transport logistics and repeated flight sequences. Videos remain outside the still-photo essay.
